interfaces.function: Craft, equip, remove or repair a portable bark-and-vine mantle.

execution.progress: Craft takes 5 stationary rounds; repair 2; equip/unequip 1. repeat counts complete operations. Global pauses preserve work; interruptions release surviving unconsumed escrow once, never spent effort.

interfaces.costs: Craft: 4 actual owned bark + 2 vine, 5 stationary rounds at 1.5 energy. Repair: unequipped owned mantle + 2 bark + 1 vine, 2 rounds at 1 energy; equal mass of worn panels becomes scrap. Equip/unequip: 0.5 energy, one round. interfaces.effects: One real 2.2-mass mantle, initially unequipped. Condition 160, loses 1 per equipped round. Moisture rises 0.10 in exposed rain, falls 0.02 otherwise. Only actual measured relief can share the existing thermal-refuge award. Transfer and death unequip; whole item identity persists.
